about.title: About Solvane
about.subtitle: An Intelligent Coastal & Cultural Companion for Ramanathapuram District
about.missionText: Solvane was created to make traveling across Ramanathapuram district seamless, enjoyable, and culturally enriching. From the sacred Ramanathaswamy Temple corridors and the engineering marvel of Pamban Bridge to the ghost town of Dhanushkodi, Solvane provides accurate timings, cluster-optimized day plans, and instant answers in both English and Tamil.
about.techFrontend: Modern React 19, Tailwind CSS, Vite, and responsive mobile-first UI.
about.techBackend: FastAPI (Python), SQLite database, and JWT authentication.
about.techMapping: OpenStreetMap & Leaflet with live GPS geolocation and distance calculations.
about.techAi: Hybrid rule-based itinerary optimization combined with Google AI-powered RAG assistance.
